standard.title: Develop and modify inquiry questions
standard.description: develop and modify questions to investigate a contemporary economic and business issue
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can develop and modify questions to investigate a contemporary economic and business issue at Year 9 level (AC9HE9S01). They have practised formulating inquiry questions and hypotheses in economic contexts, and have some experience modifying questions to narrow or focus an investigation. The Y10 descriptor carries the same wording — the progression is in the complexity of issues investigated and the sophistication of question modification.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students develop and modify questions to investigate a complex contemporary economic and business issue, including formulating and refining hypotheses.

nodes.label: Features of good economic inquiry questions
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can identify what makes an economic inquiry question investigable — specific, empirically grounded, and connected to a real contemporary issue.
nodes.minimum_width: Given two or three example questions of varying quality, identify which is most investigable and explain at least one reason why.
nodes.typical_width: Explain the features of a well-formed economic inquiry question — specificity, empirical groundedness, contemporary relevance, and scope that is neither too broad nor too narrow; distinguish investigable questions from rhetorical or opinion questions.
wider: Compare a research hypothesis (e.g. 'Responding to an upswing in the economy with expansionary measures will improve business productivity') with an inquiry question and explain when each is more appropriate
Analyse the questions posed in real economic reports or policy documents and evaluate how well they focus the investigation
Design a rubric for evaluating the quality of an economic inquiry question and apply it to a set of examples
nodes.hinge_reason: Students who cannot distinguish an investigable question from a vague or rhetorical one will produce unfocused investigations. Modification in node 2 only works if students can diagnose what is wrong with a question first.

response_modes.reason: Use worked examples of weak vs strong questions with explicit annotation of what makes each stronger. Criteria need to be explicit before students can apply them independently.

success_criteria: Identifies at least two features of a well-formed economic inquiry question
Correctly selects the stronger question from a pair and provides at least one valid reason

nodes.label: Developing and modifying questions
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can develop an initial inquiry question about a contemporary economic or business issue and modify it to improve its investigability — narrowing scope, increasing specificity, or reframing to enable empirical investigation.
nodes.minimum_width: Draft one inquiry question about a contemporary economic issue and make at least one modification that improves its focus, explaining what the modification achieves.
nodes.typical_width: Develop a range of questions to investigate a complex issue; modify questions to improve focus — for example, moving from broad questions like 'What factors influence decision-making in consumer and financial contexts?' to specific ones like 'What factors influence choosing a mobile phone plan?'; explain what each modification achieves and why it improves the investigation.
wider: Develop both an inquiry question and a related hypothesis for the same economic issue and explain the different investigative strategies each requires
Take a real economic question from a government report or media source and modify it to make it more investigable for a school-based inquiry
Investigate how economists frame research questions differently from journalists reporting on the same issue, and evaluate what each framing enables or constrains

response_modes.reason: Practise the modification move across multiple questions and multiple economic topics. Students need repeated cycles of draft-modify-explain to build fluency in this capability.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Applying question development and modification to varied contemporary economic issues — fiscal policy, employment, consumer decisions, globalisation — builds the transferable inquiry capability the descriptor targets. Each new issue context is a new application of the same skill.
success_criteria: Produces at least one modification to a draft inquiry question and articulates what it improves
The modified question is demonstrably more specific or investigable than the original
